source.title: The Micro Pullback Trading Strategy (Small Account Challenge)

research_notes: This benchmark label is retrospective ground truth and must never be supplied to a policy replaying April 22, 2026.

Historical SIP reconstruction independently reproduces the $8.50 area, drop below $8 and rapid reclaim, but the narration explicitly attributes the anticipatory decision to Level 2 stacked buyers and green tape.
AGPU is therefore a boundary/context benchmark for future order-flow anticipation, not a primary chart-only Micro v0.1 calibration target.
